name: Layoff Evaders
tagline: A VR fitness game where you squat and jump to escape an evil boss through office obstacles.

awards: Second Place: YUNZII AL66 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard

problem: Software engineers sit too long; the team plays on their fear of layoffs.
solution: A Unity VR game uses controller motion to detect squats, lunges and jumps, with a dashboard tracking calories and activity.
demo_moment: Team-described: dodge budget cuts by squatting in VR.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Second Place: YUNZII AL66 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard” among 134 submissions.
A topical joke as the game's premise.

lessons: Humour aimed at the room (tech layoffs) earns attention in judging.
